configuration.selected_using: 13 already disclosed GECCO periods; q50 retains73/104 baseline events, FP236->228. q95 loses10 events and is rejected.
configuration.geometry: For k=4..9: train [0,floor(N*(k-2)/10)), calibration next20% divided into4 adjacent blocks, test next10%. No random split. Reset feature context after8-slot gap in each cal/test block.
configuration.local_refit: Identical fixed method refits only on each local past prefix; this is not zero-shot transfer of GECCO weights.
configuration.labels: Original observed conductivity finite and expert-cleaned conductivity missing; other anomaly types unlabelled.
configuration.missing: Original missing target becomes all-channel unavailable. Inserted grid slots are unavailable; never interpolated. Original event IDs survive time gaps; a gap cannot confirm0->1.
configuration.baseline: Original200-tree IF with cadence-corrected original threshold grid/F1 ranking and1 false run/day,1% normal-alarm-time calibration constraints.
configuration.baseline_trial_event_diagnostics: Legacy baseline trial event counts use the full grid and may split an event at an inserted gap; only point F1 and false-alarm quantities affect baseline selection. Candidate calibration and all reported event results use original observed identities.
configuration.no_calibration_evidence: If no finite baseline calibration score or no normal exposure, use finite no-alarm threshold1.0000000000000002 (IF score is at most1), report unqualified; such periods cannot support release.
configuration.candidate_calibration: Existing default minimum1 normal day/block,2 observed blocks,4 normal days total,5 reference events across2 blocks; instant/2of3/3of5; preserve every reference event ID and normal exposure. Unknown support retains original IF.
configuration.primary_acceptance: Every one of24 periods must retain every baseline event ID and availability, with no higher false-run rate or normal alarm duration; strict pooled false-run reduction on original source axes.
configuration.outcome_policy: Run all24 before inspecting outer metrics. No changes based on fresh outcomes; failures retained. Future retuning would make these cohorts development data.
configuration.prior_exposure: Archive metadata, identity/time fields, headers and publisher source code reviewed; no selected sensor values or derived labels inspected. A qualitative published benchmark ranking was incidentally exposed, not used for model choice.
configuration.upstream_limitation: Publisher intermediate3.1 preprocessing provenance is incomplete. This establishes our own temporal isolation conditional on published inputs; end-to-end raw-instrument causality is unverified.
configuration.scope: Four series share one pond experiment,15-minute cadence; conductivity observation anomalies only. No MAWRID field efficacy, water safety probability, five physical fault classes, or3D/Pi performance claim.

semantics: Configuration and source hashes declared before first row/label parsing for this evaluation. Prior source exposure must be separately disclosed in configuration.
